title: Relaypad: Remote Play & Live
shortDescription: Stream PS5 & PS4 games to Twitch, YouTube, Kick, TikTok. No PC or capture card.
requires: Requires a PS5 or PS4 console with Remote Play turned on in its settings.
tagline: Relaypad connects your Android phone to your own console and sends the game live to Twitch, YouTube, Kick, TikTok or any RTMP server. It is also a Remote Play client and controller, at home or away.

sections.title: Live Stream PS5 and PS4 Games With No PC and No Capture Card
paragraphs: Relaypad connects your Android phone to your own console and sends the game live to Twitch, YouTube, Kick, TikTok or any RTMP server. It is also a Remote Play client and controller, at home or away.

sections.title: No Screen Recording: Only the Game Goes Live
bullets: Viewers get the game picture and sound, never your on-screen buttons, panels or notifications
Game audio and mic mixed separately; one tap hides and mutes the game

sections.title: Console Streaming Setup Without a PC
bullets: Live mode: stand the phone by the TV and it streams while you play on the big screen
Pair your controller with the phone over Bluetooth or USB
Or play on the phone and stream at the same time

sections.title: Twitch, YouTube, Kick, TikTok or Custom RTMP
bullets: Twitch, YouTube, Kick, TikTok LIVE, Facebook and more: paste a stream key, with a guide for each
Key on your computer? Scan it as a QR code instead of typing it
Up to 1080p60, with auto reconnect, adaptive bitrate and MP4 recording

sections.title: Relaypad Pro: Facecam, Vertical 9:16 and Multistream
paragraphs: Free streams go to one platform and carry a small Relaypad watermark. Pro adds:
bullets: Facecam from the phone camera, front or back
Vertical 9:16 layouts, picked automatically for vertical platforms
Two platforms at once, or landscape and vertical together
Instant replay of the last 30 seconds
No watermark

sections.title: Free Remote Play Controller, Up to 1080p60 on Your Phone
bullets: Phone or tablet, with HEVC and HDR where supported
Away from home over 5G, 4G or another Wi-Fi, usually with no router setup
Virtual gamepad with five layouts, or forward a Bluetooth or USB pad
HDMI out to a TV, picture-in-picture and FSR sharpening

sections.title: Remote Play Not Working? Connection Doctor Finds Out Why
paragraphs: 18 checks for network, console standby, Wi-Fi band, latency and NAT type, with a report you can email to us.

sections.title: Free to Download, No Ads
paragraphs: Remote Play, the controller and live streaming at up to 1080p60 cost nothing. No ads, no time limit.

sections.title: Privacy
paragraphs: No Relaypad account or server in between: the stream goes straight from your phone to the platform you pick. Stream keys stay on your device, encrypted. Anonymous statistics can be turned off.

sections.title: Before You Install
bullets: You need your own console; no games or cloud gaming are included
Streams use the console's remote picture (up to 1080p, no HDR), so a capture card is still sharper
To play on the TV while streaming, the controller connects to the phone, not the console
Live streams stop if you leave Relaypad or lock the screen (picture-in-picture is OK)
TikTok and some platforms give stream keys only to eligible accounts, with a new key per stream
Android 8.0 or later; a console system update may require a Relaypad update

sections.title: Something Not Working? Email Us
paragraphs: Before leaving a review, write to feedback@dapplebyte.com or use Settings → About → Send feedback.
